response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), fractions AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, CAST(examination_count AS REAL) / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, AVG(fraction) OVER () AS average_fraction FROM fractions) SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, fraction - average_fraction AS excess FROM compared WHERE fraction > average_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
